Variants.Content: Tolero Aeksio is located in the Loras Islands in the north of the Narrow Sea, and is politically within the shipping lanes of the city-state of Loras and its islands. It is a town, a center where surrounding populations, markets, roads and local power converge. Walls and roads tied the surrounding population, storage, and garrison here; even if the flags were changed, this stronghold would still affect how nearby people paid taxes, traded, and sought refuge.
Entry Tolero Exso Local families also rely on fishing, salt spray, stone harbors, fog routes, and entrepot trade; if any road, well, or dock fails, the price falls first on them.

Entry Tolero Exso If you can supply supplies, avoid danger, and find a guide, it is worth marking in your itinerary; if you don't have these three things, no matter how loud your family name is, it won't be able to save the lost.

Those who repair Tolero Axl are familiar with the workshops, markets, roof tiles, church bells and alleys that have expanded through the ages; those who comfort the bereaved are familiar with the robed monks, the ruins of the labyrinth and the islanders' traditions of loneliness. A stronghold was therefore not just a lord's hall, but also a place where weddings and funerals, vows, labor and local memories recurred.

Entry Tolero Exso They care about fishing, salt spray, stone harbors, shipping routes in the fog, and entrepot trade. They also look at whether seeds are left after harvesting grain, and whether the city gates are open in times of disaster. When people from afar see coats of arms, what they see is whether there will be food to eat tomorrow.
